node.subject: english
node.name: 追踪代词与概括性指代
node.definition: 判断代词或指示短语引用的人、物或前述事件。

lesson.definition: 判断代词或指示短语引用的人、物或前述事件。
lesson.foundation: 对应关系通常受单复数、人称、语义角色和话题连贯性约束。
lesson.principle: this 或 that 能指整句所描述的事件。测试时用名词短语或事件概括替换，观察前后是否一致。
lesson.approach: 从相邻句列候选，再检查一致性。长段中借助主题连续性缩小候选范围。

examples.prompt: Lena placed the cups on the tray. They were still warm. They 指？
examples.solution: they 要求复数，cups 与 still warm 相符，tray 是单数。

examples.prompt: The team shortened the form from four pages to one. This made it easier for residents to apply. This 指？
examples.solution: this 指缩短表格这一改变。其作用是降低填写负担。

lesson.error: 只看最近的名词。将候选内容代回，确认数量和动词语义。
lesson.standard: 能写出指代对象，并给出至少两条线索支持。
lesson.application: 跨段理解时要识别 this change、such measures 等对前述做法的概括。

questions.prompt: Ruth brought two maps. One was outdated. One 指？
questions.explanation: one 从刚提到的两张地图中取一个。

questions.prompt: The city added shade trees along the road. This reduced summer heat. This 指？
questions.explanation: this 代回整件事才能解释降温。

questions.prompt: We stored the tools in boxes. The boxes were carried upstairs, where the team opened them. them 指？
questions.explanation: 上楼后被打开的是装工具的箱子。

questions.prompt: Kai tested a larger wheel instead of the old one. It rolled farther than the old wheel. It 指？
questions.explanation: 句子把 it 与旧轮对照。

questions.prompt: The organizers moved the talk online. That allowed more people to join. That 指？
questions.explanation: that 复指前面的整个措施。
